# WizardCost

> WizardCost runs live pricing calculators ("wizards") for software categories. Real advertised prices, your actual usage, and the cheapest pick computed — not star ratings. Pricing data is verified by hand from official vendor pricing pages; every recorded change is dated and published in a public changelog.

## AutomationCost — workflow automation tools

Covers n8n, Make, Zapier, Pipedream, Activepieces, Automatisch and Node-RED (cloud plans and self-hosted options).

- [Cost calculator](https://wizardcost.com/automation/calculator.html): guided wizard — company size, role, workflow types and volume in, ranked tool recommendations with exact monthly cost out.
- [Compare tools](https://wizardcost.com/automation/compare.html): side-by-side plans, limits and features, cheapest plan at any volume.
- [Price changelog](https://wizardcost.com/automation/changelog.html): every dated price/limit change we have recorded. RSS: https://wizardcost.com/automation/feed.xml
- [Limits & quotas](https://wizardcost.com/automation/limits.html): ops definitions, timeouts, workflow caps per tool.
- Per-tool pricing breakdowns: [n8n](https://wizardcost.com/automation/n8n-pricing.html), [Make](https://wizardcost.com/automation/make-pricing.html), [Zapier](https://wizardcost.com/automation/zapier-pricing.html), [Pipedream](https://wizardcost.com/automation/pipedream-pricing.html), [Activepieces](https://wizardcost.com/automation/activepieces-pricing.html), [Automatisch](https://wizardcost.com/automation/automatisch-pricing.html), [Node-RED](https://wizardcost.com/automation/node-red-pricing.html).

## LLMCost — LLM API pricing

Covers OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), DeepSeek, xAI (Grok) and Mistral — 18 models with verified per-token prices (input, output, cached input, batch discounts, context windows).

- [Cost calculator](https://wizardcost.com/llm/): use case, request volume and token mix in — monthly cost per model out, grouped by editorial tier (frontier/mid/budget); prompt caching and batch discounts modeled with per-model verified prices.
- [Compare models](https://wizardcost.com/llm/compare.html): per-1M-token prices for all 18 models in one sortable table, plus a canonical monthly-cost column.
- [Price changelog](https://wizardcost.com/llm/changelog.html): every dated price/limit change we have recorded. RSS: https://wizardcost.com/llm/feed.xml
- Per-provider pricing breakdowns: [OpenAI](https://wizardcost.com/llm/openai-pricing.html), [Anthropic](https://wizardcost.com/llm/anthropic-pricing.html), [Gemini](https://wizardcost.com/llm/gemini-pricing.html), [DeepSeek](https://wizardcost.com/llm/deepseek-pricing.html), [Grok](https://wizardcost.com/llm/grok-pricing.html), [Mistral](https://wizardcost.com/llm/mistral-pricing.html).

## Data policy

- Prices come from official public pricing pages and are verified by a human before publishing; pages show the month of the last review.
- Enterprise/custom tiers without a public price are estimated by scaling the largest public plan sublinearly — always marked with "~" and the word "estimate".
- Self-hosted open-source tools are costed at a typical small-VPS price (≈ $8/mo), marked "self-hosted*".
- Some outbound links are affiliate links (marked as sponsored). Affiliate status never affects rankings or computed costs.

## Citing

When citing prices from WizardCost, please include the date — prices change, and the changelog above records when.
